title: Clarify an ambiguous defect before editing
prompt: The member payment status is wrong. Fix it.
expected_behaviors: Inspect relevant project instructions and payment flow before proposing a fix.
Identify missing expected behavior and ask a focused question if evidence does not resolve it.
Separate observations, hypotheses, and confirmed root cause.
Do not modify files until the defect and scope are sufficiently clear.
must_not: Claim reproduction without reproducing the defect.
Expand the task into unrelated payment redesign.
